thesis: The speaker argues that machine learning models are essentially 'souped up linear regression' that are easy to build but require significant expertise to train effectively. He emphasizes that these models are not magic or thinking entities, but rather 'dumb' tools that excel only at discovering complex correlations in data to output results like classifications or regression values.
